quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon press release: Infineon enters into agreement to sell NOR Flash and F-RAM (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon entered into a definitive agreement under which Winbond Electronics will acquire Infineon's NOR Flash and F-RAM business (NOR Flash memory and F-RAM products serving automotive, industrial and infrastructure customers) in an all-cash transaction; subject to regulatory approvals, the parties currently target closing in the second half of 2027. Winbond will operate the business as a standalone entity headquartered in Silicon Valley. Infineon retains its specialty memory portfolio (SRAM, HYPERRAM, nvSRAM and SONOS-based radiation-hardened memory). Peter Schiefer, President of the Automotive Division: the sale 'allows Infineon to further focus its portfolio and capital allocation on its core growth drivers'.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure; closing targeted in the second half of 2027
